user.title: WeatherFlow Lightning Trilateration
user.description:
Configure Tempest stations for lightning trilateration.

API Token: Log in to tempestwx.com, go to Settings > Data Authorizations, and generate a token.
Primary Station: Enter your station ID or coordinates as lat,lon (e.g., {local_station_id} detected from your Home Assistant integration).
Neighboring Stations: Enter a comma-separated list of nearby station IDs (at least 2 are required to calculate strikes).

To find neighboring station IDs, locate nearby stations on the Tempest Map at tempestwx.com/map and extract the ID from the station URL (e.g., in tempestwx.com/station/81149/ the ID is 81149).

error.invalid_station_id: The primary station ID appears to be a device serial number (e.g. 00172794). Please enter a valid station ID (e.g. 172103) or ensure your API Token is correct to auto-resolve it.

init.title: WeatherFlow Lightning Trilateration Options
init.description: Update configuration options for WeatherFlow Lightning Trilateration.

data_description.neighbor_stations: Comma-separated list of nearby Tempest station IDs to use for trilateration, e.g. '81149, 12345'. At least 2 are needed alongside the primary station.
data_description.api_token: Your WeatherFlow Personal Access Token, used to resolve station coordinates and device IDs.
data_description.distance_filter: Neighboring stations farther than this from the primary station are ignored, so distant stations don't skew the calculation.
data_description.max_trilateration_residual_km: How far the calculated strike location is allowed to be from what each reporting station's distance implies. If lots of strikes end up marked 'Unreliable', try raising this value; lower it for stricter, more precise fixes.
data_description.min_stations_for_trilateration: How many stations must report the same strike before a location can be calculated. A trilateration fix mathematically requires at least 3.
data_description.strike_marker_ttl_sec: How long a strike stays shown as a marker on the map before it's removed. The default of 21600 seconds equals 6 hours.
data_description.strike_bucket_settle_sec: How long to wait after the first station reports a strike before calculating its location, giving the other stations time to also check in. Increase it on slower/laggier setups if strikes are calculated before all stations report.
